_comment: Tier-0 starter for the Ferine path. A fang torn from a contrapasso-warped damned soul -- body-residue from the bolge where rage tore tooth-from-jaw (Inferno VII avaricious/prodigal; the gluttons mauled by Cerberus in Canto VI). Per [[project_class_stats_v2_locked_2026_06_14]] descent-stair starter doctrine: scales for the class without being class-named. Per [[project_ferine_mouth_slot_locked_2026_06_14]] this item ships in the ARM slot for v1 (held as a knuckle/grip weapon) and is named so the same item can MOVE to the mouth slot at Ferine L2 evolution without renaming. Bone is Dante-grounded; this is bone shaped into a piercing tooth, the body becoming-weapon. Scales primarily on STR (Ferine's high-soft-cap stat) with END (the predation requires endurance). Identity contribution from Predation in a Ferine's hands. Mundane name -- just a fang.
name: Fang
description: A long curved tooth, root-end wrapped in sinew to make a grip. Holds the warmth of what it was torn from.
